atoms.text: I have to buy some decorations for my birthday party. I want to buy purple balloons, since it is my favourite colour. I want twelve candles, because it is my twelfth birthday. Also, I want seven party hats for my friends and I. In addition, I want blue paper fans and a birthday garland. However, I don't want a pinata.
